name: dub
description: Dub link and partner tools with private workspace profiles and exact reviewed link workflows.
long_description: 61 shared tools: 22 reads/helpers and 39 confirmed operations. Current native link/partner API, schema help, exclusive private QR/token output and bounded reviewed batches.

token_file.title: Private token-only file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private token-only workspace key file; overrides selected key.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse mutations and private output file writes.

api_key.title: Workspace API key
api_key.description: Private scoped Dub workspace REST API key; separate from official OAuth sessions.

allow_destructive.title: Allow confirmed mutations
allow_destructive.description: Permit mutation execution only when the tool call explicitly confirms the exact action. Disable to refuse all mutations.
